<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="f-tM0NOAaLRZW7XPAU5v"> <mxGraphModel dx="1703" dy="934" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 autonumber
 actor User as Candidate (Browser)
 participant EditorUI as CodeEditorPanel / Monaco Component
 participant NextAPI as Next.js API (/api/code-executor/execute)
 participant Runner as Piston / Judge0 Service
 participant Sandbox as Execution Container

 %% User Interaction
 User->>EditorUI: Types code & clicks \"Run Code\"
 
 %% Local Formatting & Syntax checks (Client-side)
 Note over EditorUI: code-formatter.js checks syntax
 EditorUI->>EditorUI: formatCode() / detectSyntaxErrors()
 
 %% Sending Code to Execution
 EditorUI->>NextAPI: POST /api/code-executor/execute (sourceCode, language, testCases)
 
 %% Next.js API routing to Piston/Judge0 Service
 Note over NextAPI: Route validates inputs & calls selected service
 NextAPI->>Runner: Forward request to Runner Service
 
 %% Sandboxed Compilation & Run
 Runner->>Sandbox: Spin up secure environment
 Note over Sandbox: Run Code against test cases
 Sandbox-->>Runner: Return stdout / stderr / executionTime
 
 %% Returning Output back to Next.js API
 Runner-->>NextAPI: Response payload
 
 %% Returning Results to UI
 NextAPI-->>EditorUI: Return JSON output (output, testResults, error)
 
 %% Rendering output
 Note over EditorUI: Parse & highlight output
 EditorUI->>User: Display stdout / executionTime / test-case passed status

 "config": null
